    What’s that, you say? It might be kinda not freezing this weekend? Don’t tempt us with a good time. And while we’re already daydreaming of rooftop beers at Bok and picnics on the SRT, we’re ALSO stoked for those icy sweet treats that are best to eat in the heat. @ritasice annual First Day of Spring Celebration means free water ice for all! Here’s the scoop: All day, you can stop by any participating Rita’s location and receive a free 6-ounce Italian Ice in any available flavor of their choice, which includes their newest flavor, a Mystery @peepsbrand Italian Ice SURPRISE! According to the fine print, “custard can be added for an additional charge but is NOT included in the Italian Ice offer.” Italian Ice, wooder ice - you get the idea. Yes, there’ll probably be lines, but let’s be honest - it’s a tradition like no other. #wwwphilly #phillyfree #phillyfood #ritaswaterice
